items.title: Stifel downgrades Lowe’s to Sell, stays cautious on Home Depot ahead of earnings
items.summary: Investing.com -- Stifel has downgraded Lowe’s (NYSE:LOW) to Sell from Hold ahead of the home improvement retailer’s fiscal third-quarter results next week, with the firm also taking a cautious stance on Home Depot (NYSE:HD).

items.title: Patmos Announces Plans to Transform Former Fairfield Walmart Into New Technology Campus
items.summary: FAIRFIELD, Ala., November 13, 2026--Patmos, an independent provider of data center and technology infrastructure, today announced the acquisition of the former Walmart property, a 205,000-square-foot building on Aaron Aronov Drive in Fairfield, Alabama. The company plans to redevelop the property into a Technology Campus designed to support growing infrastructure demands for artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, colocation, and other web services.
